findings: README describes extent/block hash candidate discovery and optional Linux FIDEDUPERANGE data sharing. This is extent storage dedup, not perceptual matching or file removal. No mutating ioctl or upstream command executed.

tests.c contains3 MU_TEST cases: zero block, block_len boundaries and rename helper. Test inventory path count1 did not mean one test. Rename case relies on executable pathname existence to simulate hardlink handling; zero test passesNULL in final case rather than modified block. Needs helper source before interpreting adequacy.

dedupe.h caps120 total extents (source plus119 destinations), explicit queued/in-progress/completed ownership lists, per-request returned byte counts/status. Important transferable distinction: bytes processed, bytes shared, and full-file duplicate identity are different results.

dedupe.c only upper-clamps max_extents before subtracting1; zero/one preconditions not checked locally. Call-site reachability remains unreviewed. Kernel-success zero-byte/status0 response would requeue unchanged with no progress guard in this loop; actual kernel contract and callers unverified, so conditional observation rather than reproduced kernel defect.

On first destinationEINVAL with fs_blocksize0, code queries block size (fallback4096) and retries aligned length; alignment state is static global. Per-filesystem/multithread context needs caller review. Source bitmask alignment assumes power-of-two block size. No Linux native runtime/build/test qualification on current macOS host.

file_scan.c only selected lines540..595 and735..855 read. process_blocks zero test uses buffer->buf+dl_offset unchanged in every iteration while actual process_block uses buffer->buf+i*blocksize. Original C-function harness zero/data hashes0 instead expected1; data/zero hashes2 instead expected1. Confirms intra-buffer zero-filter bug under synthetic two-block inputs; full scan reachability/default options still need caller review.

is_file_renamed compares strings then only lstat old path existence, not inode identity; lstat anyerror returns true. Existing oldpath test does not prove alias identity. is_block_zeroed first int load assumes at least4byte aligned/readable buffer; full-block caller inspected, input constraints pending.

Whole csum-test.c read: manual print-and-compare checksum utility, not automatic oracle. Empty file returns success without digest; -b uses atoi without local positive bound, buf_len0 can lead immediateEOF behavior with no bytes processed; read one-shot accepts short positive read. No command/runtime exercised.

Read file_scan.c1..270 and900..1170; CLI selected135..185/355..400. fill_buffer resets dl_offset0 before normal block processing; csum_whole_file calls process_blocks directly after each fill. Thus constant first-block zero check is not corrected by outer-loop offset movement. Source path reachable when do_block_hash and skip_zeroes both true with non-faked multi-block buffer.

Whole opt.c/h establish defaults skip_zeroes=false and do_block_hash=false. Zero-filter defect is opt-in combination (CLI partial option enables block hashing, skip-zeroes enables zero filter), not default extent-hash path. Existing control proves local block hash omission; no filesystem-wide candidate count/performance claim.

Scanning allocates8MiB buffer per worker plus block array filesize/blocksize+1 even when do_block_hash false; wholefile checksum includes processed bytes regardless zero-filter. Missing block candidates do not by themselves prove wrong extent/fullfile digests or corrupt ioctl output. File-size change check compares total processed with previously recorded filesize; same-size mutation/identity needs remaining source.

Completed whole file_scan.c read. Child directory statx validity uses !(st.stx_mask | STATX_BASIC_STATS), unlike top-level/helper AND. Nonzero requested mask means OR cannot detect absent returned fields; this is expression-level defect, no Linux statx scenario reproduced. Regular children with parent_checked bypass per-file filesystem identity check; bind-mounted file edge case untested.

__scan_file acquires dbfile_lock and begins transaction, then dbfile_rename_file failure returns0 without abort/unlock on this branch. Source-level cleanup defect pending verification of lock implementation/caller error injection. begin/remove-hashes/commit results also not consistently handled in enqueue stage.

Scan reuse compares cached inode/subvolume,size,mtime and old-path-existence; worker later opens pathname and fiemaps without visible fstat identity revalidation against captured inode/mtime. End check only processed-size equality; same-size replacement/mutation is not excluded by this file. Full dbfile/filerec+kernel race guarantees need review.

Whole scan implementation has no final image-perceptual operation or content-byte equality oracle before grouping; it computes checksums and stores extent/block/fullfile candidates. Empty regular files skipped intentionally. Per-file open/read failures mostly log and returnvoid; aggregate incomplete-scan status propagation requires thread/CLI review.
